summary: Hand-wrote seven reader-facing console pages for the lifetime-objective family, following the four-altitude approach-page template: the family overview page, and the flow-ceiling, sibling-corpus, planner-distill, learned-leaf, reveal-sampling and suite-validation approach pages, replacing machine-generated drafts or adding a console page where only an operational README.md existed. Every number is quoted from a retained record (findings 01, 06-12, lease-map, reconciliation-01) with its source and evidence tier, negative and interrupted outcomes are stated rather than smoothed, and the flow-ceiling planner is labelled an oracle throughout. Three board figures were generated with the repository's TypeScript engine rather than drawn by hand.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
